evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"a","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01", a date without a time. POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-02"} returned 200 and the date was set. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate was null again. PATCH /todos/4 changed the date from 2026-12-01 to 2026-10-20.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with dueDate "10/01/2026" returned 400. PATCH with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400.
evidence.AC4: The API has no way to return only overdue todos. GET /todos?overdue=true, ?overdue=1 and ?filter=overdue each returned the full list, including non-overdue todos. GET /todos/overdue returned 404. The isOverdue field itself was right: done todos and todos without a date were false, and past-dated open todos were true. But the filtering the criterion asks for does not exist.
evidence.AC5: I loaded the list page HTML from the running app. Todos with dates showed <time data-testid="todo-due-date">2026-10-01</time> and 2026-10-20. The todo without a date showed none. I checked the page with curl, not the Playwright browser.
evidence.AC6: In the list page HTML, the open todos dated 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-20 had a badge reading "Überfällig" (capital Ü). The done todo with a past date and the todo without a date had no badge. The criterion says lowercase "überfällig"; the badge has a capital initial, which is normal for a label. I did not check this in the browser.
evidence.AC7: The list page HTML contains no control labelled "nur überfällige"; grep for it returned 0 matches. The diff of Home.razor adds no filter control.
